title: Analytical Procedures (Identity of iron) [Identification] [Basic Coating Premix Red]
description: Core quality information (2.3.3.AP) for Analytical Procedures (Identity of iron) [Identification] [Basic Coating Premix Red].

action.title: Procedure
action.description: According to USP/NF – Monograph “Ferric oxide”    Test: Identification Test A Instead of the solution of ferric oxide described in USP/NF, use a solution with the same concentration of basic coating premix red and compare the results with a solution of Red KIRSCH2358 (international reference)
